mapping.summary: Syncs orders, customers, items, stock and prices between Shopware 6 and BC
claims: Supports B2B and B2C Shopware shops
Imports Shopware orders with addresses, payment method, carrier, discount codes, vouchers and notes
Creates or links the BC customer automatically or manually
Customer-specific prices via BC customer price groups
Exports new and changed items including variants
Webshop Cockpit PIM tool for item data inside BC
Maintains category trees and attributes in BC
Blocks or hides shop items from BC
Optional module: HTML editor for shop item descriptions
Optional module: syncs shipping and payment status and sends tracking IDs back
Optional module: provides shipping and invoice documents to buyers
Works with DMS or third-party shipping modules
Runs on BC online and on-premises
